title: Fix pingwatch's pyproject.toml
problem: pingwatch is a small src-layout project (src/pingwatch/cli.py is finished and correct). Its pyproject.toml has four mistakes, and setuptools refuses to build it. Fix pyproject.toml only. The tests read it with tomllib, so nothing is installed and no network is needed. Optional, after the tests pass: in a throwaway venv, run `python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"` (this downloads setuptools, httpx, pytest and ruff) and then `pingwatch https://pypi.org/simple/`.
requirements: httpx is a runtime dependency of the project, declared with a minimum version (>=), not an exact pin
pytest is only needed for development: it goes in the dev extra next to ruff, not in the runtime dependencies
The `pingwatch` command points at the main() function in src/pingwatch/cli.py, written as an import path
Keep the name, version, requires-python and [build-system] as they are
contract: pyproject.toml with [build-system], [project] (including dependencies), [project.optional-dependencies] dev, and [project.scripts] pingwatch = "<module>:<function>"
expectedBehavior: tomllib shows `dependencies` inside [project]; httpx has a >= lower bound; the dev extra lists pytest and ruff; the script target resolves to src/pingwatch/cli.py:main
edgeCases: A key belongs to the last [table] header above it, however far away that header is
In the src layout, import paths start inside src/
Development-only tools must not be installed for every user
hints: Conceptual: run the tests and read each message. Three of them come from where a line is, or what's written in it, not from a missing feature. TOML has no indentation rules: a key belongs to the nearest [header] above it.

Specific: the `dependencies` line sits under [project.scripts], so TOML reads it as a script called 'dependencies'. Move it up, under [project], and fix what's inside it. An entry-point string is an import path such as package.module:function, and with the src layout nobody imports anything called 'src'.
Implementation: under [project], dependencies lists only httpx with a lower bound (httpx>=0.27); pytest>=8 joins ruff in the dev list; the script target becomes pingwatch.cli:main.
evaluation: Version constraints are minimums (or ranges), not exact pins, in [project] dependencies
